paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: First GrAHal pathfinding run at liquid He temperature sets a single exclusion limit g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22x KSVZ) around 6.375 GHz (m_a = 26.37 ueV = 2.637e-5 eV) at 95% CL. Paper assumes axions constitute all local dark matter but gives no explicit density value. Limit spans only a narrow tuning range around one frequency, so a single point is extracted. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('union of') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 1))
